acceptanceCriteria: Changing one declared outcome parameter fact changes both runtime parsing/schema behavior and interface description output without a second manual fact table.
CLI and MCP capability descriptions, generated reference regions, and actual accepted defaults/enums/requiredness remain parity-checked and deterministic.
Two description generations are byte-identical and description generation performs no repository scan, validation, or verification subprocess.
No lifecycle, authorization, Outcome delivery, or host-confirmation semantics change.
goal: Make the BAML-style interface description for work-item outcome derive defaults, enums, requiredness, aliases, and parameter descriptions from the actual adapter definitions, with deterministic parity evidence.
intent: Eliminate duplicated interface facts for the work-item outcome discovery surface so actual CLI/MCP definitions and generated descriptions share one authoritative source.
outOfScope: Outcome lifecycle and host delivery behavior
